heading: 13.5 Explicit rounding
text:
### 13.5 Explicit rounding [LUNI.13.5]

`<amount>.round("<mode>")` rounds a currency-typed value to its storage's
minor-unit precision and yields the same dimension at exact `int64`.
`<amount>.round_to(<unit>, "<mode>")` rounds to a coarser unit in the same
dimension (e.g. `.round_to(USD_dollar, "half_up")` from `currency_usd`).

The mode is a **string literal** (not a bare identifier or keyword), so no mode
name is a reserved word. String args are unambiguous in
the parser, validate at compile time, and follow the established pattern
of `decimal` libraries in Python / Java / JS.
